cells: **CC0 1.0 — verified AT THE SOURCE GRANT, 2026-11-04:** the repo `LICENSE` is the full CC0 1.0 Universal legal code verbatim (fetched raw from GitHub), and the repo README declares the project aim as "a digital human solution that is Creative Commons Zero, effectively Public Domain". No per-file headers exist in the texture set, so the grant is read from the repo-level LICENSE — the same file-level standard rows 26/27 hold, applied at the only level the publisher provides.

2 eye BaseColor Utility EXRs, 4096² float32 linear sRGB: `Vitruvian_Iris_BaseColor_Utility - Linear - sRGB.exr` (sha256 `029bb1b8…40755`, linear max 0.32, photographic centred iris with golden collarette, no catch-light) + `Vitruvian_Sclera_Cornea_BaseColor_Utility - Linear - sRGB.exr` (sha256 `d320212d…c2c9e9d0`, BGRA, front-centred disc with grey/teal placeholder, white vein band, pink conjunctiva band). Staged read-only at `/Volumes/files/openclinxr-assets/store/vitruvian-src/4K/` (SHA256SUMS-verified 2026-11-04 — both files byte-match). HumanShaders/VitruvianGodot PNGs explicitly NOT taken (licence unclear).

`tools/openclinxr/asset-pipeline/eyes/vitruvian_eye_resample.py` polar-resamples both EXRs into the existing 1024² eye UV (iris r_disc→133.5 px, limbus 30 px, pupil stamp r≤38, sclera inner-band resample + desaturated pink) producing `tools/openclinxr/asset-pipeline/eyes/vitruvian/vitruvian-iris-{hazel,brown,green,blue}.png` + repo-authored `hazel.mhmat`; hazel = source as-is, brown/green/blue = OKLCH remap. `iris_palette.vitruvian_iris_texture` / `iris_diffuse_override["hazel"]` expose them; `materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py` consumes hazel via the same TEXTURE_OVERRIDES slot. No mesh/UV/shader change.

**Keep.** CC0 is the cleanest posture; no attribution obligation. slice 4 of the Vitruvian plan; slices 3+ share the same row for the source grant (Face Height EXR is a separate intake when a slice consumes it).
